title: Rain on Tent Sounds for Sleeping - No Thunder | Pine Forest 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of steady rain on a small tent pitched in a tall pine forest at night. Soft taps on the tent close by, the hush of rain on the forest outside and the odd heavier drip from the pines. No thunder, no music, no talking.
The rain never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep, reading and study.

0:00:00 Rain begins
0:00:10 Rain on the tent (8 hours)

Valley & Tide - nature sounds from wild places, for deep sleep.
New sessions every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

Scenes and sounds are original, created with AI tools and edited by Valley & Tide.
